description: The plot titled “ReDial” illustrates how two metrics, Recall@50 and NDCG@50, vary across five x-axis positions while also showing horizontal reference baselines. The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 1 to 5 with tick labels at every 1 unit. The left y-axis is labeled “Recall@50,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.30 to 0.60 with tick labels spaced by 0.05. The right y-axis is labeled “NDCG@50,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.15 to 0.22 with tick labels spaced by 0.01. A green solid line with circular markers labeled “Recall@50 (Ours)” increases across x, starting near 0.35 at x=1 and rising to about 0.49 at x=5, with intermediate points around 0.43 (x=2), 0.47 (x=3), and 0.48 (x=4). A green dotted horizontal line (legend entry obscured) sits at approximately 0.47 on the Recall@50 axis and remains constant across all x values. A blue solid line with square markers labeled “NDCG@50 (Ours)” increases from about 0.16 at x=1 to about 0.19 by x=4 and remains at roughly the same level at x=5, with intermediate values around 0.18 at x=2 and about 0.185 at x=3. A blue dotted horizontal line labeled “NDCG@50 (ReFICR)” is constant at approximately 0.155 across the full x-axis range.
